description: A // line comment inside an interpolation in a heredoc is ignored
notes: The spec allows comments inside interpolation sequences, but a line comment counts as a newline, and the spec doesn't say newlines are ignored inside interpolations. hashicorp/hcl ignores them: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(false) before parsing the expression, and its peeker skips comments.
